skill.name: scientific-slides
skill.description: Build research presentation decks with planning guidance, visual design rules, AI-generated slide imagery, PowerPoint workflow notes, and LaTeX Beamer templates.
skill.summary: Create structured, visual scientific presentations for talks, seminars, and defenses.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, LaTeX notation, placeholder URLs, and presentation-design language. Confirmed risks remain around OpenRouter network egress, API key handling, parent-directory .env loading, external pdflatex execution, sudo installation guidance, and parent-directory script references. The package also includes a prior self-audit file that claims the skill is safe, which should not be trusted during marketplace review.

remediation.issue: API key is accepted and forwarded through command-line arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Pass the key through the child process environment or standard input instead of argv, and avoid documenting inline secret values.

remediation.issue: The AI image generator sends prompts and attached images to OpenRouter.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear user consent language before network calls and warn users not to attach confidential research data without approval.

remediation.issue: The script searches parent directories for .env files.
remediation.suggestion: Limit dotenv loading to the current project or an explicit --env-file path, and document which variables are read.

remediation.issue: Validation runs pdflatex on user-selected TeX files.
remediation.suggestion: Document that untrusted TeX should be compiled in a sandbox or container with shell escape disabled.

remediation.issue: Documentation recommends sudo package installation and ../ sibling script execution.
remediation.suggestion: Replace sudo commands with dependency checks and explicit user confirmation, and avoid invoking scripts outside the packaged skill directory.

remediation.issue: A prior evaluation file declares the skill safe inside the package.
remediation.suggestion: Remove EVALUATION_OUTPUT.json and any self-attestation content from the distributed skill package.

content.value_statement: Researchers need clear slides that explain complex work without dense text. This skill helps plan, generate, review, and refine scientific presentations.
actual_capabilities: Plans conference, seminar, defense, journal club, and grant presentation structures.
Provides slide design guidance for typography, layout, color, and accessibility.
Generates AI slide images and standalone visuals through OpenRouter when configured.
Combines generated slide images into PDF decks with the included script.
Validates timing, slide count, and basic PDF, PPTX, or Beamer presentation properties.
Includes LaTeX Beamer templates for common scientific talk formats.
limitations: AI image generation requires an OpenRouter API key and network access.
Generated slide images may need manual review for text accuracy and figure fidelity.
PowerPoint editing depends on a separate PPTX skill or a user-provided workflow.
LaTeX validation requires local dependencies such as pdflatex and Python libraries.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Conference Talk
use_cases.description: Turn a research abstract and results into a timed visual deck with citations and clear slide goals.

use_cases.title: Redesign a Seminar Deck
use_cases.description: Convert dense academic slides into a cleaner narrative with stronger visuals and better audience pacing.

use_cases.title: Review a Defense Presentation
use_cases.description: Check slide count, timing, readability, and visual issues before a thesis or dissertation defense.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Talk
prompt_templates.prompt: Use scientific-slides to outline a 15-minute conference talk about [topic]. Include slide titles, timing, key points, and suggested visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Slides
prompt_templates.prompt: Use scientific-slides to review my current deck notes for [audience]. Identify dense slides, missing visuals, timing risks, and clearer narrative flow.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Visual Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Use scientific-slides to create prompts for AI-generated visuals for slides on [methods/results/topic]. Keep text minimal and specify a consistent visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Build and Validate a Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Use scientific-slides to plan, generate, assemble, and validate a full [duration]-minute presentation for [event]. Include review steps and final quality checks.

output_examples.input: A 12-slide machine learning conference talk with three main results.
output: A timed slide outline with title, motivation, methods, three results, limitations, and closing slides.
Visual suggestions for each result slide and citations for background claims.
A review checklist for readability, slide count, and presentation pacing.

output_examples.input: A dense results slide with a complex chart and six bullet points.
output_examples.output: A revised slide concept with one headline message, a simplified chart focus, larger labels, and two supporting bullets.

output_examples.input: A LaTeX Beamer thesis defense deck that may be too long.
output_examples.output: A timing review that compares slide count to the defense duration and flags sections that need compression.

best_practices: Start with the talk duration, audience, and one core message before designing slides.
Use figures, diagrams, and short labels instead of paragraphs on presentation slides.
Validate generated decks visually before presenting, especially text size and contrast.
anti_patterns: Do not paste paper sections directly into slides as long paragraphs.
Do not generate AI slide images without checking factual text and data accuracy.
Do not attach confidential figures to external image services without permission.

faq.question: Does this skill create PowerPoint files directly?
faq.answer: It provides PowerPoint workflow guidance and visual assets. Direct PPTX editing depends on a separate PPTX workflow.

faq.question: Can it generate slide images?
faq.answer: Yes. The included scripts can call OpenRouter models when an API key and network access are available.

faq.question: Can it work without network access?
faq.answer: Yes for planning, design guidance, templates, and local validation. AI image generation requires network access.

faq.question: What presentation formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill covers image-based PDF decks, PowerPoint workflows, and LaTeX Beamer templates.

faq.question: Is it suitable for confidential research?
faq.answer: Use local planning features for confidential work. Do not send private data to external image services without approval.

faq.question: Does it replace rehearsal?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure and validate slides, but speakers still need to practice timing and delivery.
